messages:
emily: Quick follow-up from postmortem: recurring cache-evictions. Need three small deliverables for the runbook: (A) a 5-step fast-triage, (B) copy-paste ops commands, (C) an escalation ladder with timeboxes + owners. Volunteers?

raj: I can write the 5-step fast-triage. Draft: 1) confirm scope (model vs cluster), 2) snapshot kvcache hit-rate, 3) inspect eviction events/reasons, 4) apply immediate mitigation (shard tweak or fallback route), 5) tag incident + notify. Will make each step one line.

toni: I will add the ops commands (exact text to paste). Proposed snippets:
```bash
# eviction events (30m)
redwoodctl telemetry events list --type=eviction --since 30m

# kvcache hit-rate (5m)
redwoodctl metrics query "increase(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m])"

# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 200

# fallback to compact model
redwoodctl route set --model model-compact --traffic 100% --reason "eviction-fallback"
```

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1720 created and linked. Reminder: runbook updates due in 7 days.

marc: I'll own the escalation ladder. Suggest: oncall ack <10m, eng-sre engaged <20m if not mitigated, eng-runtime notified <45m, leads + customer-sre at 90m. I'll build role-based primary/secondary contacts and confirm rotations.

emily: Add telemetry markers to the runbook: 95th token latency jump, kvcache hit-rate drop >25%, eviction-rate spike. Also include a one-line playbook: when unsure, reduce traffic to suspect model before mass restarts.

raj: ACK. Will publish the 5-step triage + a short mitigations section (due in 2bd).

toni: ACK. I'll open a PR with the command snippets + sample outputs (due in 3bd).

marc: ACK. I'll post the escalation table and SLA timeboxes (due in 4bd) and schedule a 20m review.

emily: Thanks all  we'll track these in the postmortem action tracker and close when merged.
